runs.question: Does the pull toward the minimum circuit hold on other target classes and on real data?

verdicts.measured: cost-4 0.72, symmetric 0.90, DNF 0.67 held; noisy 0.58 neither
verdicts.bar: held if ≥ 0.65 in ≥ 3 of 4 classes; broken if ≤ 0.50 in ≥ 2

verdicts.measured: Breast Cancer 0.29, Diabetes 0.45 broken; Digits 0.56 neither; Wine 0.74 held
verdicts.bar: held if ≥ 0.60 in ≥ 3 of 4 datasets; broken if ≤ 0.50 in ≥ 2

verdicts.measured: Occam minus kernel agreement ≤ 0 in 4 of 8 cells (DNF, Breast Cancer, Digits, Diabetes)
verdicts.bar: held if ≥ +0.02 in ≥ 6 of 8; broken if ≤ 0 in ≥ 4

verdicts.measured: net minus kernel accuracy: Breast Cancer +0.07, Wine −0.07, Digits −0.03, Diabetes −0.04
verdicts.bar: held if ≥ +0.01 in ≥ 3 of 4; broken if ≤ 0 in ≥ 3

runs.learned: The theory holds for clean, structured targets, including classes it was not built on, and fails on real data. Label noise is the likely boundary: the noisy synthetic class is the weakest, real cell labels are noisy, and the exact-fit minimum circuit generalizes worst on all four real datasets. On real tasks the kernel also beats the trained net on 3 of 4.

gaps_moved.why: Three further clean classes held; the failing condition (noise) is characterized
Tested and failed: the gap is now a theory that predicts on real data
Opened by this run: the noise boundary and conjecture C20

runs.question: Under label noise, do nets follow a simpler circuit plus memorized exceptions? (C20′, exact cost–error frontier)

verdicts.bar: held if drop from 0 to 8 flips ≥ 0.10; broken if ≤ 0.02
held if ≤ −0.02 at 0 and ≥ +0.02 at 8; broken if ≤ 0 at 8

verdicts.measured: simpler minus kernel agreement: Wine +0.05, Digits −0.02, Diabetes −0.01; Breast Cancer no verdict
verdicts.bar: held if > 0 in ≥ 3 of 4; broken if ≤ 0 in ≥ 3

verdicts.measured: accuracy of simpler minus exact: +0.042 at 5 flips, +0.014 at 8
verdicts.bar: held if ≥ +0.02 at both; broken if ≤ 0 at both

runs.learned: Label noise removes the pull toward the minimum circuit quickly: two flipped labels in 48 take it from 0.83 to 0.66. Noise does not move the net to a simpler circuit; it makes the net less like any circuit (best agreement 0.89 → 0.75). Exploratory: a two-part-code circuit from the compiler generalizes better than the trained net under noise.

gaps_moved.why: Dose–response established; the proposed predictor is not supported
Still no predictor that beats the kernel on real data
